---
title: "Clinical Study on Depression"
params:
  lang: "en"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

task <- "onesamplet1"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

hook(xbar, mean(X))
hook(s_D, subscript(s, D))
hook(mu_0, subscript(mu, 0L))
hook(n, N)

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n <- as.integer(round(runif(1, min=20, max=45)))
  mu_0 <- round(runif(1, min = 18, max = 28), 1)
  s_D   <- round(runif(1, min = 4, max = 9), 1)    

  t <- runif(1, min = 0.5, max = 3.0)
  xbar <- round(mu_0 + t * s_D / sqrt(n), 1)

  tratio <- (xbar - mu_0) / (s_D / sqrt(n))

  if(tratio < 0.5 || tratio > 3.0)
    next

  Q <- quote(search(onesamplet1, tratio(xbar, mu_0, s_D, n),
    .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
```

Question
========
Consider a clinical study in which $N=`r n`$ patients have a mean depression score of $\overline{X}=`r xbar`$ on the Beck Depression Inventory, 
with a standard deviation of $s_D=`r s_D`$. To test whether the mean depression score is higher than the reference value $\mu_0= `r n`$, 
calculate the corresponding $t$-ratio.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The $t$-ratio is given by : `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```

Meta-information
================
extype: schoice
exsolution: `r mchoice2string(t$correct, single=TRUE)`
